report: Facebook drove the most volume (2,880 leads) but showed substantial lead-to-application leakage at 0.87% L2A, yielding 23 enrollments and a CAC of 47,966.74. Google converted more strongly at 3.13% L2A and 94.12% A2E, but had the highest observed CAC at 74,456.50; database also showed warm-to-application leakage, with 370 warm leads but only 12 applications (3.24% W2A). Referral, affiliate, and website posted 100% A2E but on only 2, 3, and 5 applications respectively, while cost comparisons are limited because spend is available for just 3 of 8 sources.
